verdict.rationale: Tilled is a payments platform for software vendors, so splitting a charge across multiple sellers is a fair axis to judge it on. The evidence never shows multi-party splits, a platform fee on a charge, or reversible split or transfer objects. Merchant pricing templates and console voids or refunds are adjacent features, not split-payment routing.

support.subject: As a developer, I can split one charge among any set of parties — route funds to multiple sellers, take my cut, and reverse or adjust the split later, all as first-class API objects
